notes: Curated eval for a runnable weekly content-ops model. Routing keeps governance separate from one-time gap inventory and backlog work.

should_trigger.prompt: Please design a practical content ops system for revenue enablement content, including taxonomy, ownership, lifecycle controls, and quality checks.
Please reduce content sprawl, define source-of-truth rules, or operationalize publishing and retirement workflows.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable content governance system and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please audit revenue enablement content coverage and prioritize the highest-impact gaps by role, stage, and use case.
Audit our Highspot inventory and produce a 90-day backlog of create, update, consolidate, and retire work.

Please diagnose an unclear field-performance problem or design the cross-functional wrapper for a multi-intervention revenue enablement initiative, including charter, capacity, pilot, governance, rollout, and measurement.
Please synthesize multi-source field feedback into traceable themes, segment differences, evidence limits, and owner-ready actions for enablement, product marketing, sales leadership, or product.

output_structure_checks.name: content-governance-weekly-cadence
output_structure_checks.description: Names the weekly operating cadence: who does what, on which day, and what done means.

output_structure_checks.name: content-governance-two-axes
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps publication status and review status independent, with live assets remaining published while due or overdue.

output_structure_checks.name: content-governance-approval-boundary
output_structure_checks.description: Separates content approval from authorization to publish or change a live system.

output_structure_checks.name: content-governance-not-inventory
output_structure_checks.description: Does not substitute a one-time gap backlog for the operating model, or invent usage or ROI.
